item.title: Group reports totals by account and currency
item.brief:
Implement operator requirements: read CSV stdin, accept legacy CSV without currency as USD, validate present currency as exactly 3 uppercase ASCII letters and on malformed input print stderr error and exit 2. Aggregate totals by account and currency; output account,currency,total_cents sorted account then currency. Update README, pass python3 -m unittest, and commit locally. Follow shared CSV contract and the ledger member's branch/contract.

item.title: Add currency field to ledger TSV-to-CSV
item.brief: Implement operator requirements: accept optional fourth TSV column currency; missing means USD; validate exactly 3 uppercase ASCII letters; malformed currency reports line number on stderr and exits 2 while other input failures keep exit 1. Emit CSV header date,account,amount_cents,currency and currency on every row. Update README, pass cargo test, and commit locally. Follow shared CSV contract.

pr.summary: Added optional transaction currency to ledger TSV conversion. The exporter now emits the shared four-column CSV contract and defaults omitted currency to USD; before it emitted three columns with no currency.
